title: Save on your next trip with these hotel booking apps
raw_text:
Finding and booking the right hotel can make or break your trip's budget.
Your lodging is likely a big portion of your overall costs. After all, the average daily rate for a room in the U.S. was $168 per night in March, according to real estate data group CoStar. And costs are on the rise: hotel prices increased 4.3% year-over-year in April, according to the U.S. Travel Association's Travel Price Index.
Booking your stay through the right platform can help keep expenses down, freeing up more funds for adventures and experiences. And apps can give users a simple experience they can use on the go.
Below, CNBC Select looks at our favorite hotel booking apps that can help make your trip planning simple. (See our methodology for more on how we picked the best hotel booking apps.)
Offers in this section are from affiliate partners and selected based on a combination of engagement, product relevance, compensation, and consistent availability.
Who's this for: Hotel Tonight helps you find last-minute deals from a selection of curated hotels while also earning credit you can use with Airbnb, making it a great option for those who stay in both hotels and vacation rental accommodations.
Standout benefits: The brand's app has been highly rated in Apple's App Store for its ease of use and convenience, including earning an Editor's Choice award.
Standout features
Book over 1,000 mid- to upscale hotels across the U.S. and the world that have been handpicked by the app.
Rewards
Offers a credit equal to 10% of every booking you make through the app to use on Airbnb.
App rating
4.9 out of 5 stars with 584,000 reviews on Apple App Store
4.3 out of 5 stars with 70,000 reviews on Google Play Store
Who's this for? If you're not looking for a specific brand and are open to learning where you'll stay after you book, Hotwire's deals help you book upscale hotels affordably. These discounts could help you get an experience you might otherwise miss.
Standout benefits: While you won't know the exact name or address of your hotel, Hotwire's map feature makes it easy to narrow your search to specific areas, so you can be in the neighborhood of your choice.
Standout features
You can find upscale hotels at affordable prices with this app, which offers blind bookings. While you won't know specifically which hotel you'll get, you'll know several brands that it could be. The site states that it offers four-star hotels for the price of a two-star hotel, so you'll likely get a good bang for your buck. In addition to hotels, you can book cars, flights and packages.
Rewards
No traditional rewards program, but does offer app-exclusive deals and exclusive discounts.
App rating
4.8 out of 5 stars with 145,000 reviews on Apple App Store
3.9 out of 5 stars with 16,000 reviews on Google Play Store
Who's this for? Costco Travel can help members find deals on a variety of resorts, including luxury and all-inclusive properties. You can even book full travel packages including flights and rental cars to make planning easy.
Standout benefits: Those with the Costco Anywhere Visa® Card by Citi can earn 3% cash back on airfare, hotels, car rentals, and cruise lines booked with Costco Travel.
Standout features
While only available to Costco members, Costco Travel is a travel agency that allows you to book hotels, resorts, flights, cruises and other experiences. All-inclusive options are available, and travel packages are handpicked by Costco's travel experts.
Rewards
Some vacations allow you to earn digital shop cards that can be redeemed at Costco Wholesale or online at Costco.com, and Executive Members who purchase directly from Costco Travel earn a 2% Reward after travel is completed.
App rating
4.9 out of 5 stars with 1.2 million reviews on Apple App Store
4.7 out of 5 stars with 407,000 reviews on Google Play Store
Who's this for: Based in Singapore, Agoda is a standout booking platform for travel throughout Asia. However, it has a wide variety of accommodations available around the world, including destinations in Europe and the U.S.
Standout benefits: You can also earn Agoda Cash to put toward future stays on some properties that have partnered with the booking site. Agoda also offers discount codes in the app for additional savings.
Standout features
Agoda searches over 3.9 million hotels, resorts, bed-and-breakfasts and even villas and homes worldwide to help you find the accommodation that's perfect for your trip. The platform offers low rates on monthly stays and package deals that include flights.
Rewards
Properties with the Agoda Cash symbol in their listing allow you to earn funds you can put towards future stays on the platform. Unlocking AgodaVIP status can also help you save more on select properties.
App rating
4.8 out of 5 stars with 175,000 reviews on Apple App Store
4.6 out of 5 stars with 2.2 million reviews on Google Play Store
Who's this for? If you also want to compare Airbnbs or VRBOs, Booking.com shows hotels, vacation rentals and bed-and-breakfasts all in one place.
Standout benefits: Booking.com's Genius rewards program can help you earn 10% off at some properties just for signing up.
Standout features
Booking.com searches hotels, guest houses/vacation rentals, and other types of accommodations worldwide to help you save on travel.
Rewards
Booking.com's loyalty program, Genius, allows you to get up to 10% discounts on stay (before taxes and fees) at it's most basic tier. And, those who complete 15 bookings in 2 years can save up to 20%.
App rating
4.8 out of 5 stars with 2 million reviews on Apple App Store
4.8 out of 5 stars with 4.9 million reviews on Google Play Store
Booking a hotel that fits your budget is possible, but you might need to do some work before you find the best deal.
Checking a comparison site or aggregator, like those listed above, can help you see a wide variety of options. Trying a few apps can help you see many price points, accommodation types and possible properties.
Once you've found a few options that fit your criteria, check the hotel's site directly. Sometimes hotels offer lower prices on their own websites than elsewhere, so it's worth a look.
Use travel credit cards to your advantage when you book, from getting your trip insured to earning rewards and free nights.
In fact, some credit cards will cover your bookings with travel insurance. This can help in certain situations, like if you have to cancel your trip due to an unexpected illness or injury in your family, or if you're injured or ill abroad and need to seek treatment. What's the best way to book a hotel affordably?
Using an aggregator tool to browse options in your price range is a good way to start. For domestic U.S. travel, we recommend using tools like Hotel Tonight and Booking.com to see a variety of options. Then, compare prices, including the cost of booking with points or miles, as well as the price of the hotel when booked directly through the property's website.
Is it cheaper to book directly through a hotel?
It can be cheaper to book a stay directly through a hotel or resort's website, but it's always a good idea to shop around before you pay for a stay.
How can I save money on my hotel booking?
A great way to save money on your hotel booking is to be flexible: If you're not tied to a certain property or neighborhood, using a tool like Hotwire can help you get a deal on a property you might otherwise not consider. While you won't know before you book which exact property it is, you'll get information on the general area, hotel reviews and ratings and cost (including any fees) to help you decide if it's a fit.
CNBC Select reviewed more than a dozen top travel aggregator apps with hotel availability in the U.S., focusing on room site functionality, discounts, the ability to earn rewards, and pricing transparency.
We assessed based on the following features:
- Site functionality: Ease of use on desktop, as well as mobile app features. We considered the star rating and number of reviews for each app on the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
- Discounts: We reviewed the discount opportunities available through each app, including frequency of coupon codes and additional, stackable discounts.
- Rewards programs: We looked at the ability to earn rewards on these apps and websites, prioritizing those that let you accumulate rewards over time.
- Pricing transparency: We prioritized apps that showed transparent pricing, prioritizing those that included a trip's total cost including fees in search results.
We also considered CNBC Select audience data when available, such as general demographics and engagement with our content and tools.
Based on these criteria, we chose the best hotel booking apps and sorted our picks by:
- Best for booking last-minute: Hotel Tonight
- Best for a surprise hotel: Hotwire
- Best for cheap resorts: Costco Travel
- Best for international travel: Agoda
- Best for variety: Booking.com
